target: H1 source-level observed algorithmic work reduction, conditional on quality and paired numerical equivalence; not an energy or H2 claim.

contrasts.interpretation: sparse traversal under same local-learning rule
active-index reuse under same sparse local-learning rule

pilot_decision_rules.rule: For a given contrast, all five planned paired seeds meet learnability, quality and numeric parity gates, and candidate observed source-event work is strictly lower than reference for each seed under a pre-approved fixed metric; report all seeds and raw components.
pilot_decision_rules.interpretation: Narrow pilot support for source-level work reduction only.

pilot_decision_rules.rule: All five planned paired seeds are quality- and numerically comparable, but candidate has no lower observed source-event work in any seed.
pilot_decision_rules.interpretation: No advantage in the tested tiny workload; not universal falsification.

pilot_decision_rules.rule: Mixed work signs, a missing/failed seed, non-equivalent numerical paths, missed quality or learnability gates, unresolved weights/units, or incomplete provenance.
pilot_decision_rules.interpretation: Do not declare a quality-matched saving. Report all available observations and failures.

mandatory_reporting: All five seeds and paired per-seed effects (no posthoc exclusions)
Accuracy and calibration outcomes for every arm and seed
Predefined failure ledger and effect range; no broad p-value claims
Software versions/commit/data digest and measurement overhead
CPU wall/RSS only if instrumented and separately disclosed
explicit_limitation: This is a conservative proposed rule for independent critique. Unit cost weights, numerical tolerance and actual learnability are unresolved. No observations exist.
